column1: SITES YOU WILL PROBABLY NOT GET (BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF)
cars.com — DR 92. Major automotive publisher. They feature established brands with thousands of reviews. Cold email will likely be ignored.
usnews.com — DR 93. Major news outlet. Their car shipping rankings are likely pay-to-play or editorial-only. Cold outreach success rate: <1%.
cartalk.com — DR 82. Established editorial. Might respond if pitch is exceptional but don't count on it.
consumeraffairs.com niche edit — DR 86. The directory listing (Person B) is doable. But getting editorial mention requires their paid accreditation program.
Keep these in your pipeline and try once per quarter. But don't waste weekly time repeatedly pitching them.
